description: Reference ground truth for the annotated episodes at the Lidoire mill. Keyed by peak date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), not by the historical EP numbers, which are inconsistent across code and docstrings. Extracted from backend/validate_model.py, backend/analyze_episodes.py and the docstrings of backend/app/services/risk_v2.py, then revised on 2026-10-26 from the owner's answers (see each episode's statements).
caveats: Not exhaustive: every negative is a model detection (risk score or river threshold); floods the model missed were never labelled, so POD/miss rate cannot be computed from this set alone. The 2026-02-12 flood is the only label added from the owner's memory rather than from a detection.

peak_time is naive UTC, as in InfluxDB. The owner states times in Europe/Paris local time (CET = UTC+1 in winter, CEST = UTC+2 in summer); each statement keeps the local time as stated and peak_time holds the converted UTC value.

peak_time_precision_hours is the +/- half-width of the peak time uncertainty. Labels never revisited by the owner keep day-level precision (12 h): their 06:00 or 12:00 times are conventions, not observations.

severity is a 1-5 field required for every episode: for floods it describes damage, for non-floods it is the estimated hazard level of the detection. Do not compare severities across outcomes. The 2026-02-12 severity is a placeholder (not stated by the owner).

outcome near_miss of 2024-03-30 and 2025-11-25 is an interpretation of the owner's notes ('bien monte', 'haut'); the 2023-12-11 near_miss is the owner's own word ('c'etait presque mais non', 2026-10-26).
legacy_stored_score is the risk score stored at peak by an older model (validate_model.py 'old'), kept only for regression comparisons; it is not ground truth.
Production database ids differ from legacy_db_id: find an episode by its date with GET /api/episodes before confirming it.
inconsistencies: EP14 is the 2023-11-30 night flood (25 cm inside) in validate_model.py / analyze_episodes.py and in the risk_v2 momentum comment (5 rising, river=0.602), but risk_v2 v3.2 docstring and conjunction comment call 'EP14 April 23' (Pessac 0.62, Abzac 0.93, Coutras 0.87) the April 2025 flood, which is id=1 in the scripts and 'episode avril 2025 (id=1)' in the v2.2 docstring. Resolved by date keys; the April 2025 flood is keyed 2025-04-21 since 2026-10-26.

risk_v2 docstring says '5 confirmed floods, 9 false positives' but 2026-01-28 is noted 'en cours, pas encore inonde' (outcome not known when labelled) and two non-floods are near misses rather than false positives.
2023-03-11 flood was caused by infiltration (since sealed): the mechanism no longer applies, it should probably be excluded or weighted down in evaluation.
CLAUDE.md and the detector default start at 2022-11-01 but the earliest labelled episode is 2023-01-18.
calculate_risk_score_v2 docstring says weights were 'calibrated from Feb 2024 episode' while the module docstring says v3.0 was calibrated on all 14 episodes.
Non-flood episodes carry severities up to 4 (2026-01-28) and 3 (2025-11-25, 2023-12-11), as high as or higher than the 2023-03-11 flood (3).

Resolved 2026-10-26: 2023-12-11 was labelled flooded ('continuation decembre 2023'), the owner says it was a near miss; the December 2023 flood was keyed 2023-12-01T06:00 and the April 2025 flood 2025-04-23T16:00 (wrong day), both re-keyed to the owner's times; the 2024-02-26 height (25 vs 20-25 cm in the two scripts) is 20-25 cm.
